name: Reghuram Kesavan
title: Aerospace Engineer | Aerodynamics · CFD · Flight Physics · Scientific Computing
summary: Aerospace Engineer completing the Master in Aerospace Engineering at ISAE-SUPAERO (Major: Advanced Aerodynamics & Propulsion), with graduate aerospace studies at the Technical University of Munich (TUM). Specialized in low- and high-fidelity aerodynamics, RANS CFD, scientific Python tool development (VOROM-X, ApexSim, TRACE FanGEO), high-lift experimental wind-tunnel testing, and propulsion–airframe interaction, supported by professional aerospace test and mechanical engineering experience at Lilium.

education.details: Major: Advanced Aerodynamics and Propulsion. Key Coursework & Verified Grades: Advanced Aerodynamics (15/20), Numerical Fluid Mechanics (15/20), Fluid–Structure Interaction (16/20), Project Management (20/20), Computational Aeroacoustics. Master's Thesis on TRACE FanGEO turbomachinery design workflow.
Completed 57 ECTS in Aircraft Design, Aircraft Performance, Theoretical & Experimental Aerodynamics, Composite Materials & Structures, Control Engineering, Aeroelasticity, Aerospace Structures.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology (Honours) in Mechanical Engineering
education.details: Official CGPA: 9.28 / 10.0. Honours Thesis on Aerodynamics of Passenger Aircraft with Distributed Electric Propulsion (DEP).

experience.description: Defined structural test requirements and designed custom test fixtures and support hardware for lightweight composite sandwich panels in Siemens NX with ASME Y14.5 GD&T. Conducted pre-test nonlinear FEM in ANSYS Workbench to predict stress concentrations and fixture stiffness, managing multi-part assemblies, drawing packages, and engineering changes under controlled PDM workflows in Teamcenter.

Performed low-Reynolds-number aerodynamic and configuration analysis for an ~2 m fixed-wing UAV using XFLR5 and ANSYS Fluent; generated 3D surface geometry in SolidWorks and supported prototype flight testing and subsequent aero design iteration.
Enhanced structural performance and evaluated buckling margins of CFRP cryogenic propellant tanks for student sounding rockets under combined internal pressure and axial launch loads.
Evaluated surface treatment processes at Titanium Sponge Plant. Supported assembly and maintenance of industrial compressor systems.
